items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law, what is the maximum period of suspension without pay that an employer can impose as a disciplinary penalty on a worker?
items.gold: Suspension without pay for a period not exceeding 14 days.
items.fact: Disciplinary unpaid suspension capped at 14 days under UAE Labour Law

items.question: Under Article 40 of the UAE Labour Law, what is the maximum period an employer may temporarily suspend a worker while conducting a disciplinary investigation?
items.fact: Temporary suspension during disciplinary investigation maximum 30 days
